armor.name: Armor of the Undying
armor.description: A curse passed on, an armor that stays death. Choose the right weapon, recover what is lost.

armor.name: Bounty Master Armor
armor.description: A hunter seeks challenge. A killer seeks precision. A bounty is won.

armor.name: Crimson Kimono
armor.description: A kimono stained red with blood. Imbued with a mother’s love to shroud its wearer from danger.

armor.name: Dragonfly Armor
armor.description: Daijiro’s armor, before forgoing the name Lord Furuya. A note reads: “May your arrows fly with the speed of a dragonfly.”

armor.name: Fundoshi
armor.description: The best revenge is cold and silent.

armor.name: Ginji’s Guard Armor
armor.description: A prototype crafted by Ginji, the armorer, to protect its wearer from incoming gunfire.

armor.name: Ina’s Armor
armor.description: Slightly singed and smells of black powder.

armor.name: Kanemori’s Two-Faced Mask
armor.description: A cursed mask, plagued by the double nature of its previous owner. Cursed: The wearer will take increased damage, but also deal increased damage to their enemies.

armor.name: Mercenary Attire
armor.description: A versatile outfit that hides both dust and blood.

armor.name: Nine Tail Armor
armor.description: Worn by the shinobi haunting Teshio Ridge. Designed for stealth and cunning.

armor.name: Onryō Armor
armor.description: The armor of a wandering hunter on the lonely path of revenge.

armor.name: Robes for Sitturaynu
armor.description: Made by huci to help a lost hunter find their way.

armor.name: Snake Skin Armor
armor.description: Once worn by the notorious Yōtei Six member known as the Snake. Smells of blood, smoke, and sake.

armor.name: Spider Lily Armor
armor.description: The armor of a general, lost to grief. All enemies fall to its bloodthirsty intent.

armor.name: Taro’s Armor
armor.description: An armor for the resilient survivor. Assembled by Taro from the fallen of Ezo.

weapons.name: Dual Katana
weapons.description: When one katana isn’t enough. Effective against Polearms such as Yari or Naginata.

weapons.name: Kusarigama
weapons.description: A sharp kama chained to a counterweight, allowing for a wide range of attacks. Effective against Shields.

weapons.name: Odachi
weapons.description: A massive blade that can cut down even the largest opponents. Effective against Brutes.

weapons.name: Wolf Blade
weapons.description: A masterpiece forged by Master Kengo to protect his family.

weapons.name: Yari
weapons.description: Polearm with a razor-sharp blade and long reach. Effective against Sickles such as Dual Kama or Kusarigama.

weapons.name: Hankyu
weapons.description: Medium bow with moderate damage and draw speed.

weapons.name: Tanegashima
weapons.description: Matchlock rifle that pierces any defense. Inflicts severe damage, but takes considerable time to reload.

weapons.name: Tanzutsu
weapons.description: Matchlock pistol that pierces any defense. Inflicts moderate Ranged damage and Stagger damage. Shoot an enemy actively attacking to perform a Pistol Parry.

weapons.name: Yumi
weapons.description: Longbow that inflicts considerable damage at a great distance. Slow draw speed. Can pierce helmets.

weapons.name: Bombs
weapons.description: Throwable explosives that can change the tide of battle.

weapons.name: Kunai
weapons.description: Throwing dagger that inflicts major Stagger damage.

weapons.name: Smoke Bomb
weapons.description: Release a cloud of smoke to hide your movements. Perfect to escape battle—or close in for the kill.

weapons.name: Tanto
weapons.description: A short blade used for assassinations.

charms.name: Charm of Cursed Spirit
charms.description: Curse: Actions that use Spirit cost twice as much. While cursed, Ghost Flowers have a minor chance to drop from enemies.

charms.name: Charm of Frailty
charms.description: Curse: All successful enemy attacks are fatal. Onryō’s Will is disabled. While cursed, Ghost Flowers have a moderate chance to drop from enemies. Life saving effects from Techniques, Charms, and weapons are disabled.

charms.name: Charm of Misfortune
charms.description: Curse: No longer gain resources or ammo from fallen enemies. While cursed, Ghost Flowers have a minor chance to drop from enemies.

charms.name: Charm of Amaterasu
charms.description: Defeating enemies regains a moderate amount of Health.

charms.name: Charm of Futsunushi
charms.description: Parries, Perfect Parries, and Perfect Dodges are easier to perform.

charms.name: Charm of Sukunahikona
charms.description: Regain a [?] portion of health while not in combat.

charms.name: Charm of Taming
charms.description: Playing the shamisen turns nearby hostile animals into allies.

charms.name: Charm of Thoughtful Restoration
charms.description: A reflection ripples in the water and the mind. Gain a [?] increase to maximum Health.

charms.name: Father’s Charm
charms.description: A gift from your father, so your sword flows like a brush stroke. Perfect Parries regain a [?] amount of Health.

charms.name: Charm of Fortitude
charms.description: Moderate chance to survive lethal damage and gain Spirit.

charms.name: Charm of Healing
charms.description: While at half Health or less, potency of the Heal Technique increases by a minor amount.

charms.name: Charm of Inner Fire
charms.description: Blizzard damage is reduced by half.

charms.name: Charm of Last Chance
charms.description: Heal Technique triggers automatically when suffering lethal damage from combat. Heal Technique costs one third of max Spirit.

charms.name: Charm of Mount Yōtei
charms.description: A relic left by one who walked with the mountain’s blessing.

charms.name: Charm of Resourceful Protection
charms.description: Blocking an Arrow has a [?] chance to add it to your inventory.

charms.name: Charm of Stolen Flame
charms.description: Automatically ignite your weapon by Parrying a fire attack or Blocking a Fire Arrow. While ignited, your weapon is unblockable.

charms.name: Takezo’s Charm of Bold Deflection
charms.description: Parrying inflicts a [?] amount of additional Stagger damage.

charms.name: Takezo’s Charm of Bracing Victory
charms.description: Killing Staggered enemies earns a minor amount of Health.

charms.name: Takezo’s Charm of Renewed Determination
charms.description: Earn a minor amount of Spirit when taking damage from an enemy.

charms.name: Takezo’s Charm of the Stout Heart
charms.description: Increase potency of the Heal Technique by a [?] amount.

charms.name: Charm of Drunken Mastery
charms.description: While drunk, attacks make enemies Vulnerable. All Melee weapons inflict maximum Stagger damage against Vulnerable enemies.

charms.name: Charm of Hachiman
charms.description: Maximum Standoff Streak increased by 1. After a successful Standoff, an additional enemy will rush in and open themselves to a killing blow.

charms.name: Charm of Iron Grip
charms.description: You cannot be Disarmed.

charms.name: Charm of Takemikazuchi
charms.description: Heavenly Slash has a moderate chance to unleash a lightning strike against a nearby enemy. There is a 30 second cooldown between successful strikes.

charms.name: Charm of Yamatotakeru
charms.description: Earn a moderate amount of Spirit after Disarming or killing an enemy with a thrown Melee weapon.

charms.name: Charm of the Drunkard
charms.description: While drunk, your attacks are unblockable, but you will be unable to Block enemy attacks. Total duration of your drunken state is decreased, lasting for a [?] time.

charms.name: Charm of Cannon Steps
charms.description: The Yari’s Typhoon Kick has a [?] chance to instantly Stagger an enemy.

charms.name: Charm of Confident Strikes
charms.description: A [?] chance to gain 1 Spirit when Staggering an enemy with the Katana.

charms.name: Charm of Defensive Blade
charms.description: Recover 1 Kunai after performing a Perfect Dodge.

charms.name: Charm of Drunken Adversary
charms.description: Enemies killed in a Standoff have a minor chance of carrying lootable Sake.

charms.name: Charm of Fiery Rage
charms.description: Increase the duration of Oni’s Flame by a [?] amount.

charms.name: Charm of Fire Mastery
charms.description: Oni’s Flame inflicts additional damage. Heavy Attacks with ignited weapons spread fire to nearby enemies.

charms.name: Charm of Fortune’s Grip
charms.description: If Disarmed, your weapon lands closer and you earn a Sake jar.

charms.name: Charm of Furious Attacks
charms.description: The Dual Katana’s Tempest Strike deals a [?] amount of additional damage.

charms.name: Charm of Hidden Blades
charms.description: Throw [?] additional Kunai.

charms.name: Charm of Quick Retrieval
charms.description: When you Disarm an enemy, immediately pick up their dropped weapon.

charms.name: Charm of Resolute Victory
charms.description: Standoff victories earn additional Spirit per enemy killed.

charms.name: Charm of Shattering Strike
charms.description: Shields destroyed with the Kusarigama unleash an explosion of shrapnel inflicting [?] Stagger damage to nearby enemies.

charms.name: Charm of Swift Reward
charms.description: Enemies defeated during a Standoff have a minor chance to drop throwable weapons.

charms.name: Charm of Thunderous Assault
charms.description: Staggering an enemy with the Odachi grants a [?] chance to knock down that enemy.

charms.name: Charm of Eager Revenge
charms.description: Reduce the kill streak requirement of Ghost Stance by 1.

charms.name: Charm of Howling Terror
charms.description: Reduce the kill streak requirement of Onryō’s Howl by 1.

charms.name: Charm of Masakado
charms.description: Onryō’s Will revives you at full Health.

charms.name: Charm of Mauling
charms.description: Wolf attacks make enemies Vulnerable for a [?] duration. All Melee weapons inflict maximum Stagger damage against Vulnerable enemies.

charms.name: Charm of Onryō’s Protection
charms.description: Taking damage reduces kill streak count by [?] instead of resetting it. Kill streaks power Onryō’s Howl and other deadly techniques.

charms.name: Charm of Onryō’s Wrath
charms.description: After using Onryō’s Will, you have a [?] chance to trigger Onryō’s Howl.

charms.name: Charm of Terrors
charms.description: Increases all chances to Terrify by a [?] amount.

charms.name: Charm of Wolf Stalking
charms.description: Assassinations in areas where the wolf can be summoned have a [?] chance to summon the wolf instantly. The wolf performs a stealth assassination if able.

charms.name: Charm of Fearful Defense
charms.description: When killing an enemy after a Perfect Parry or Perfect Dodge, the chance to Terrify nearby enemies is increased by a [?] amount.

charms.name: Charm of Fearful End
charms.description: All types of Assassinations have a [?] chance to Terrify nearby enemies.

charms.name: Charm of Fearful Mastery
charms.description: Disarming enemies has a [?] chance to Terrify nearby enemies.

charms.name: Charm of Fearful Strike
charms.description: Headshot kills have a [?] chance to Terrify nearby enemies.

charms.name: Charm of Amenowakahiko
charms.description: Headshots have a moderate chance to earn Spirit.

charms.name: Charm of Kibitsuhiko
charms.description: Land headshots while using Concentration to extend its duration by a [?] amount.

charms.name: Charm of Raining Arrows
charms.description: The Hankyu rapidly fires arrows with automatic aim. Arrow damage is increased by a moderate amount, but disables headshots.

charms.name: Charm of True Aim
charms.description: The Yumi locks-on to enemies and fires Arrows, inflicting massive damage. Arrows auto-target up to enemies.

charms.name: Mother’s Charm
charms.description: A gift from your mother. Her presence on the wind quickens your Arrows, increasing their damage by a [?] amount.

charms.name: Charm of Archer’s Fortune
charms.description: A moderately increased chance to recover Arrows that kill or miss their target.

charms.name: Charm of Brutal Volley
charms.description: Increase damage of thrown Melee weapons by [?] amount.

charms.name: Charm of Burning Blades
charms.description: Kunai now inflict Fire damage and ignite flammable objects.

charms.name: Charm of Fatal Silence
charms.description: Arrows are silent on impact.

charms.name: Charm of Firewalking
charms.description: Fire Arrows set the ground on fire in a [?] radius.

charms.name: Charm of Hokkyokusei
charms.description: A northern star. A guide to those who take aim. It grants a minor chance to not consume Ranged weapon ammo.

charms.name: Charm of Iron Focus
charms.description: Increases total Concentration time by a [?] amount.

charms.name: Charm of Soaring Focus
charms.description: Earn infinite Concentration when aiming a bow or rifle while jumping.

charms.name: Charm of Tanzutsu Guard
charms.description: Interrupting an attack with the Tanzutsu has a chance to regain 1 bullet.

charms.name: Charm of Venomous Cloud
charms.description: Metsubushi now inflicts Poison which deals [?] Stagger damage over time.

charms.name: Charm of the Prepared
charms.description: The Tanegashima reloads while stowed.

charms.name: Charm of Confusion
charms.description: Assassinations on enemy Leaders will Confuse them, turning them into an ally for a [?] duration. The Leader dies when the effect ends.

charms.name: Charm of Izanagi
charms.description: All types of Assassinations regain a [?] amount of Health.

charms.name: Charm of Masaka
charms.description: Using a Smoke Bomb regains a [?] amount of Health.

charms.name: Charm of Assassin’s Resolve
charms.description: Assassinations other than Kusarigama Assassinations grant a minor amount of additional Spirit.

charms.name: Charm of Lingering Shadows
charms.description: Reduce enemy detection speed by a [?] amount.

charms.name: Charm of Opportunity
charms.description: Automatically loot assassinated enemies.

charms.name: Charm of Surprise Gift
charms.description: Assassinated enemies have a [?] chance to drop their weapon.

charms.name: Charm of the Blind Drunk
charms.description: Throwing Sake jars at enemies will briefly Blind them.

charms.name: Charm of the Wary Opponent
charms.description: Press  to focus on an enemy who has begun to detect you.

charms.name: Charm of Homusubi
charms.description: Inflict increased Fire damage to enemies.

charms.name: Charm of Kanayago
charms.description: Increase the amount of common and rare metals, and black powder collected when scavenging.

charms.name: Charm of Abundant Drink
charms.description: Increases the amount of Sake you can carry by 1.

charms.name: Charm of Bountiful Harvest
charms.description: Increase the amount of wood, flowers, and plants gained when collecting them.

charms.name: Charm of Enduring Resolve
charms.description: Abilities that use Spirit have a [?] chance to regain 1 Spirit.

charms.name: Charm of Generous Opponents
charms.description: Chance to recover Quickfire ammo when looting the dead.

charms.name: Charm of Lingering Affliction
charms.description: All harmful status effects on enemies last moderately longer and deal a moderate amount of additional damage.

charms.name: Charm of Risk and Reward
charms.description: Kills regain a minor amount of Health, but you take increased damage.

charms.name: Charm of Uncanny Aim
charms.description: Quickfire weapon damage increased by a moderate amount.

charms.name: Charm of Unhealthy Resolve
charms.description: Kills earn a [?] amount of Spirit but your maximum Health is reduced.

charms.name: Charm of Vanity
charms.description: Increase the duration of cooking perks by a [?] amount.

charms.name: Charm of the Iron Stomach
charms.description: You can drink 1 additional Sake before becoming drunk.

charms.name: Takezo’s Charm of the Unrelenting Warrior
charms.description: Deal bonus damage while at low Health.

charms.name: Toku’s Charm of Blessings
charms.description: Increase Spirit earned by a minor amount.
